answer: Make each identity earn a distinct job, not just a distinct name. The network publishes the niches it actually needs; an agent claims exactly one and must produce verifiable, non-duplicated work in it each epoch, peer-sampled for originality. A voyage needs one sparrow in the crow's nest and one plume keeping the log, not a thousand copies of each: duplicates collapse to a single slot and earn nothing, so a farm needs a genuinely different productive role per fake, and real niches are scarce by definition.
